text: this is good. the brush variety is actually not bad. i would however, not ship this with the approach u have for the brush choice, i would turn the svg into an icon and use that icon as the brush choice over a name oh also the one thing with this color wheel that is a problem and has always been a problem is you click on a color and unless you bring the mouse out of focus and back into focus u cant select a new color.

events.text: Done (5034bb056): brush picker is now SVG-path icons (paint/icons.ts + BrushIcon, verified in shot — all 11 shapes render as glyphs); ColorField long-standing click bug fixed (stuck drag-overlay on a no-move click → per-element drag refs, no overlay).

resolution: Delivered both pieces of UI feedback on the paint kit. (1) The brush picker is now SVG-path ICONS instead of names: runtime/paint/icons.ts draws each of the 11 brush shapes as path layers (brushIconLayers), rendered by a new BrushIcon (Graph.Path) and laid out as an icon grid in BrushKit — verified in rjit shot, all shapes render as crisp glyphs; the same path is the seed for the Phase B host stamp mask. (2) Fixed the long-standing ColorField click bug (click a color, couldn't pick another until moving focus out/in): root cause was a no-move click setting dragging=true on mousedown while the 'only-when-dragging' overlay hadn't mounted to reset it, so it stuck and ate the next click — replaced the overlay with per-element drag refs on the wheel/value Pressables. The click fix needs a live rjit dev confirm (not headless-testable).
